The eMudhra Certificate Authority Incident Is A Wake-Up Call For Enterprise PKI
The private key of a certificate authority (CA) should be one of the most secure secrets in digital infrastructure. In eMudhra’s case, eight CA private keys turned out to not be very secret. AI Agents Need More Than Least Privilege — They Need Least Agency
The problem isn’t necessarily excessive
access
— it’s excessive agency. Least privilege primarily constrains
access

access
but also authority and autonomy:

access

access
to the platform. The third stage is deployed, where users are aware of the technology but haven’t integrated it into workflows or processes yet; workarounds are prevalent.

False
accept
rates measure how often attacks are incorrectly
accepted
as genuine; it’s the most critical security metric because it directly reflects fraud risk under real attack conditions. Great performance is typically below 0.1% (0.01% in stricter benchmarks), 0.1%–1% is good, and 1%–5% is acceptable. False reject rates measure how often legitimate users are incorrectly rejected; it reflects usability and business impact, including customer friction and support costs.

Best Practices: Insider Risk Management
All Data Theft Is An Inside Job — And It Will Cost Your Business Data theft requires
access
to the data. That
access
is either obtained by external actors who, using compromised credentials, masquerade as insiders, or granted to an insider as part of their job. Insiders can be any employee, contractor, partner, or vendor who has
access
to your firm’s data and systems. AI agents are also emerging as a nonhuman insider risk as they are given
access
and autonomy to carry out their objectives.
